themes.description: 10 champion buffs, 7 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Letting people use spiritual weapons inside of an arena was probably not the greatest idea. Structured changes across 24 entities this patch.

champions.name: Akali
champions.tldr: Base damage increased to 45–145 from 40–140.; Energy cost reduced to 110–70 from 130–70.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akali is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.
